metadata.explanation: Task requires verifying that all papers have arxiv links in column B. The original file has 1 paper (row 2) with an arxiv link already filled ('https://arxiv.org/pdf/2309.16609v1.pdf'). The evaluator checks if all rows with paper titles have corresponding arxiv links filled in column B. Since the current file already has the link filled, the task would be satisfied as-is, but allows for future papers to be checked.
